svg.title: Sling angle factor and mode factors
svg.text: Sling angle factor 1/cos θ, leg force for the HMC 500 (W = 117.72 kN) and mode factors of slings (EN 1492-2 / EN 818-4)
θ = angle of the leg FROM THE VERTICAL (this guide, the app)
β = 90° − θ = angle to the horizontal (some charts)
α = 2θ = included angle between two legs
Leg force F = W / (n · cos θ) (n legs that carry)
4 legs: count only 3 → F = W / (3 · cos θ)
Horizontal pull on the lug H = F · sin θ
4 legs share equally: W/(4 cos θ)
4-leg rule, 3 legs carry: W/(3 cos θ)
kN per leg, W = 117.72 kN (12 000 kg).
4 Mode factors M (WLL of the assembly = M × WLL of one sling / one leg) – values of EN 1492-2 (round slings) and EN 818-4 (chain, grade 8)
Example: 4-leg round slings 5 t at 0–45° → 2.1 × 5 = 10.5 t < 12.12 t hook load ✗; 6 t → 12.6 t ✓. With the exact angle 30° and 3 legs: 3 × cos30° × 5 t = 12.99 t ✓.
Choke hitch: choke angle ≥ 120° for M = 0.8 (smaller angle → lower). Slings on edges need edge protection. WLL already contains the safety factor (round sling 7:1, chain 4:1).
EXAMPLE – check the maker's installation manual
Sling angle factor and mode factors
Values from docs/28 and web/instseq_calc.js (example data, crankcase line HMC-01/02/03).
